Declare an immutable resource record

Source: R/resource.R
resource.Rd

A resource record names one concrete artefact: exact bytes, at one or more locations, under one version label. Once published, a record is immutable. If a publisher reissues the same nominal file with different bytes that is an upstream mutation, not a routine update, and getaca reports it as such.

Usage

resource(
  name,
  version,
  urls,
  sha256,
  size = NA_real_,
  license = NA_character_,
  description = NA_character_,
  upstream = NULL,
  processor = NULL
)

Arguments

name

Resource name. Must be usable as a directory name.

version

Version label for these exact bytes, for example "2026.1".

urls

Character vector of download locations, tried in order. All must be https://.

sha256

Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file as served.

size

Expected size in bytes, or NA. Used to detect truncated transfers before hashing.

license

License identifier for the data, for example "CC-BY-4.0".

description

One-line human description.

upstream

Optional named list identifying what these bytes were built from, when the artefact is derived rather than an original release. A prepared database records both its own build identity and the upstream release it was made from, and both travel into provenance.

processor

Optional processor() applied after verification.

Value

An object of class getaca_resource.

Examples

resource(
  name = "wfo",
  version = "2026.1",
  urls = "https://example.org/wfo-2026.1.parquet",
  sha256 = strrep("a", 64),
  size = 1048576,
  license = "CC-BY-4.0"
)
